fundamentals.name: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of fiber-optic networking products in the United States, Taiwan, and China. The company offers optical modules, optical filters, lasers, laser components, subassemblies, transmitters and transceivers, turn-key equipment, headend, node, and distribution equipment, as well as amplifiers. It sells its products to internet data center operators, cable television, telecom equipment manufacturers, fiber-to-the-home, and internet service providers through its direct and indirect sales channels. Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Sugar Land, Texas.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing revenue and strong analyst estimates are offset by current unprofitability and high valuation multiples.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates by 44.8%; next earnings date is 2026-08-06.
positives: Revenue growth 51.4% YoY, with current Q estimates at 109.4% and FY estimates at 441.7%.
PEG ratio of 0.78 suggests growth may justify the current valuation.
Strong balance sheet with a current ratio of 3.83 and quick ratio of 2.85.

negatives: Operating and profit margins are negative (-8.6% and -8.5% respectively).
Return on equity and assets are also negative (-6.1% and -3.3%).
Free cash flow is negative at $-445.58M TTM.
Forward P/E of 37.54 and Price/Sales of 28.35 are high, indicating a premium valuation.

news.paragraph: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) has seen significant positive momentum, with shares soaring on executive commentary highlighting the growing role of optics technology and reports of major AI and DOCSIS wins. The company is doubling its Texas capital expenditures, signaling strong future demand, particularly for its 800G and 1.6T technologies. This surge is part of a broader rally in the optics sector, with analysts expressing bullish sentiment on the company's growth prospects.
